conditional_unique_keys.bookings.occupied_slot_id: Generated slot_id for requested, accepted, completed or closed; otherwise NULL.
conditional_unique_keys.booking_change_requests.pending_booking_: Generated booking_id only for pending requests; otherwise NULL.

derived_not_stored: Five UI steps: Booking, Arrange, Class, Payment, Verified

merged.payment_reviews: Current tutor/admin evidence decisions in payment_submissions; current/final admin aggregate decision in payments.

payment_rules.expected_amount: bookings.expected_amount; never changed by a receipt
payment_rules.contributing_submission: Current version with tutor_status=received AND admin_status=valid
payment_rules.valid_total: Sum amount_paid once per genuine transfer, never across receipt versions
payment_rules.correction: New attempt under SAME transfer_id; old version and reviews retained but excluded; both reviews restart for that transfer
payment_rules.top_up: NEW transfer_id for a genuine additional payment; student enters its own amount, not a cumulative total
payment_rules.final_verification: Admin only; both class completions, exact expected valid total, resolved current evidence, matching evidence_revision; atomically close booking
payment_rules.overpayment: Manual Admin/support; no automated refund, excess revenue or reversal
payment_rules.review_history: Receipt version history with latest tutor/admin decisions per version; no event-by-event review log

integrity_rules.account: One role/subtype; username and email globally UNIQUE; IC not UNIQUE
integrity_rules.student_overlap: Lock student row before tutor/slots; reject intersecting requested/accepted bookings across all tutors
integrity_rules.slot_occupancy: UNIQUE generated occupied_slot_id plus locked validation
integrity_rules.reschedule: Counterpart consent before lesson; recheck availability/student overlap; no target holds; preserve before/after agreement and immutable original rate
integrity_rules.duration_price: Original hourly_rate_snapshot multiplied by target duration
integrity_rules.arrangement: Both timestamps; material changes increment agreement_version and reset both
integrity_rules.mode: Both directions with counterpart acceptance and tutor support; mode alone does not change fee
integrity_rules.admin_correction: Marked before/after change record with admin actor/reason; no normal edits of closed/verified transactions
integrity_rules.feedback: UNIQUE booking_id; booking student, integer rating 1-5, both completion timestamps; payment verification not required
integrity_rules.certificate: Retain multiple approved certificates; one selected owned approved certificate; no automatic ranking/expiry/revocation
integrity_rules.public_listing: Completed eligible profile may stay Public with zero future slots
integrity_rules.support: Authenticated student/tutor only; optional owned booking; admin support management does not authorize private chat
integrity_rules.sessions: Standard PHP sessions; manual admin provisioning; logged-in password change; reset-email/Remember Me deferred

report_rules.comparison: Count bookings by tutor_id; monthly filter bookings.created_at; include all statuses unless explicitly filtered
report_rules.composition: Count payments by status; monthly filter payments.created_at; never count receipt versions

resolved_decisions.Q01: Mutual participant consent, marked admin corrections, original-rate duration recalculation, no temporary holds
resolved_decisions.Q02: Both mode directions, counterpart consent, tutor capability, no mode-only price change, physical venue agreement
resolved_decisions.Q03: Both arrangement timestamps; reset on material accepted changes
resolved_decisions.Q04: Malaysia cancellation timing; manual exceptions; no automatic fees/refunds/expiry; no student overlap
resolved_decisions.Q05: Manual support/admin disputes and overpayments; closed/verified normally read-only; no reversal accounting
resolved_decisions.Q06: Multiple approved certificates retained, one displayed qualification; admin approval; no ranking/expiry/revocation
resolved_decisions.Q07: Three-table partial-payment and versioned-receipt model; final admin verification
resolved_decisions.Q08: One dashboard; booking comparison/payment composition by record dates; no report tables
resolved_decisions.Q09: Global UNIQUE username/email; one role; IC not UNIQUE
resolved_decisions.Q10: Basic registration then teaching completeness; relational languages/tags; fixed settings; Public with zero slots
resolved_decisions.Q11: 5 MB certificate/receipt/profile/QR/support; 10 MB safe chat; protected file paths/metadata
resolved_decisions.Q12: Deactivate instead of historical user deletion; retain records; no retention/anonymization automation
resolved_decisions.Q13: Manual admins, PHP sessions, logged-in password changes; remove auth_tokens and defer reset delivery/Remember Me
resolved_decisions.Q14: Authenticated support only; no unrestricted admin private-chat access
resolved_decisions.Q15: One rating 1-5 per booking after both completions, without requiring verified payment
